criteria.requirement: Implement sqlglot.report_bounds.bounded_query(query,max_rows,*,offset=0,dialect=None) using completed single-query copying and real AST builders. Wrap original query as an aliased subquery and apply outer limit/offset; never overwrite existing inner LIMIT/OFFSET/order/CTEs or apply limit independently to each UNION branch. Accept zero limit, reject negative/noninteger/bool values, preserve original AST and compile through requested output dialect. This bounds final row count, does not execute SQL or guarantee implicit order across dialects.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
